summary: Verified the /plan bug fix on Expo web preview at 1440x900. Zero runtime errors, zero console errors — the previously reported 'setAvailH is not defined' ReferenceError is fully gone. The layout is proportional: no non-uniform scale transform is present anywhere on the canvas (only identity matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0) transforms). Side rail is full-height and undistorted; header 'Your Training Plan', tabs, hero (Build & Climb + Plan Goals), Current Phase roadmap, Weekly Load, Key Workouts and Alberto's Adaptations all render with normal aspect ratios. All 5 tabs (Overview / Phases / Key Workouts / Load & Progress / Adaptations) switch content without layout distortion. Vertical scrolling works (inner ScrollView scrollHeight 1271 > 900 clientHeight). Rail navigation railnav-calendar routes to /calendar; regression checks on /calendar, /progress and /settings all render cleanly with no scaling regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: plan.tsx cleanly derives fullW from measured availW via onLayout of the ScrollView — no scale transform, no DESIGN_W, no orphan setAvailH reference. Confirmed by DOM audit: every transform on the page is identity matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0).
Layout is symmetric with the other screens (SideNavigation + ScrollView flex row) — good consistency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified end-to-end at 1440x900 landscape tablet viewport. No ReferenceError, no scale distortion. All tab and rail-nav flows are functional. Screenshots stored under /app/test_reports/screens/.
rca_of_issue: Original defect: plan.tsx was wrapping its canvas in a fixed-width DESIGN_W View with a non-uniform scale transform (scaleX≈1.125, scaleY≈0.7401) causing visual squash; a leftover reference to setAvailH after refactor also produced a ReferenceError at runtime. Fix (verified): remove DESIGN_W and the scale transform entirely; use a plain flex row of SideNavigation + ScrollView; derive fullW from onLayout-measured availW. Verified via DOM transform audit (only identity matrices remain), pageerror listener (0 errors), console error listener (0 errors), and visual screenshots on all 5 tabs.
